issue.title: Investigate two persistent ACE PNG snapshot drifts
issue.description: Discovered while verifying sase-cn after a dependency-floor-only change. The full just check and an isolated just test-visual rerun both fail tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_models_panel_navigation.py::test_models_panel_builtin_selection_effort_step_png_snapshot (1118 changed pixels, 1104 material) and tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_notification_sent_at.py::test_notification_sent_at_png_snapshot (830 changed pixels, 802 material). No presentation code or snapshot files changed in sase-cn. Inspect the generated .pytest_cache/sase-visual artifacts, determine whether the rendering change is intentional or flaky, and update implementation/goldens only with evidence.
